_comment: TARGETS_FILE (design section 11). One entry per (environment, adapter); UNIQUE(environment, adapter) means an environment may hold several adapters but only one of each. v2 ships the 'standalone' adapter across the whole promotion chain; 'apim' and 'kafka' are out of scope. v4 adds config.gatewayUrls: where the playground may send a request in that environment (plan section 11). In a real deployment this is the F5 vhost, not an instance; two entries exist for dev so calls x instances is demonstrable by hand. An environment without it has no playground, and the portal says so.

config.note: two instances, so calls x instances is visible (design section 5.7)
